author: Animalogic
description:
The greater glider is the largest gliding marsupial in the world. They're as big as a cat and can glide for up to 100 meters. They also have cartoonishly adorable ears and live on a diet of eucalyptus. They're like flying koalas from outer space. So why are we not talking about these animals all the time? Let's find out in this episode of Animalogic.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
